answer: In a decentralized AI agent network, Sybil resistance emerges through computational proof-of-work puzzles anchored to real-world resource costs. Each agent must solve cryptographic challenges requiring significant computational effort—the meadow of processing power cannot be conjured from nothing—before joining the consensus. An attacker seeking ember-like false identities faces exponentially growing difficulty as each new node demands substantial energy expenditure, turning the tide against cheap impersonation by making identity creation economically unfeasible at scale.
